definitions.explanation: A visible mass of water vapor in the sky.

examples.english: There are clouds in the sky.

examples.japanese: {雲|くも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流|なが}れている→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧。

examples.english: White clouds are over the mountains.

examples.japanese: {雲|くも}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Sunlight was visible through a gap in the clouds.

notes:
{雲|くも} means cloud - visible water vapor floating in the sky.

HOMOPHONE:
{雲|くも} (cloud) vs. {蜘蛛|くも} (spider) - same pronunciation, different kanji.

TYPES OF CLOUDS:
- {雨雲|あまぐも}: rain cloud
- {入道雲|にゅうどうぐも}: cumulonimbus (towering summer clouds)
- {綿雲|わたぐも}: cumulus (fluffy clouds)
- {鰯雲|いわしぐも}: cirrocumulus (mackerel sky)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {雲|くも}が{出|で}る: clouds appear
- {雲|くも}が{流|なが}れる: clouds drift
- {雲|くも}をつかむよう: vague, elusive (lit. like grasping clouds)
- {雲海|うんかい}: sea of clouds (scenic view from mountains)

WEATHER:
- {雲|くも}が{多|おお}い: cloudy
- {曇|くも}り: cloudy weather (related word)
